IP360_HOST.description: Base URL of the Tripwire IP360 VnE console (e.g. https://ip360.example.com).

IP360_SCOPE_ID.description: Optional IP360 scope identifier to filter scans. Omit to consider every scope.

IP360_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Minimum Faraday severity bucket to import. Valid values: info, low, medium, high, critical. Default: info.

name: tripwire_ip360
title: Tripwire IP360
description: Tripwire IP360 vulnerability scanner importer. Pulls the most recent scan via /api/2.0/vulnscans and per-device findings via /api/2.0/devices/{id}/vulns; emits one Faraday host per scanned device with severity mapped from the IP360 score (0=info, <=2500=low, <=10000=medium, <=25000=high, >25000=critical). Auth is HTTP Basic with IP360_USER + IP360_API_KEY.
